title: Conversations: every customer on one board
description: See every customer conversation as a line on one board, with each step an agent took and how long it took.

blurb: Six agents with one job each
title: Agents: six AI agents with one job each
description: Crewline runs six AI agents with one job each: Front desk, Orders and returns, Tech support, Billing, Researcher and Reviewer.

blurb: Rules you can read out loud
title: Flows: support rules you can read out loud
description: Write the rules of your shop as flows: plain steps, with limits you set, tested on real orders before they go live.

title: Knowledge: answers from your own documents
description: Agents answer from your own policies and manuals, show the passage they used, and hand over when nothing fits.

title: Damage photos: a vision model reads what arrived
description: A customer sends a photo of a torn box. A vision model on your PC reads it and the flow acts on what it sees.

title: Calls and voice: local speech in and out
description: Crewline hears callers with Parakeet and answers with Kokoro or LFM3-Audio, all on your own computer.

title: Approvals: refunds over your limit wait for you
description: Anything over your limit stops and waits, with the order, the customer's words and the rule that stopped it on one card.

title: Languages: replies in the customer's language
description: List the languages your shop speaks. Agents answer in the one the customer used and keep order details exact.

title: After hours: customer support while you sleep
description: Agents keep answering after you close and tell customers honestly when a person will be back.

title: Store data: import Shopify and WooCommerce orders
description: Import products, customers and orders from Shopify or WooCommerce exports. Agents look up real orders from then on.

title: Models: open AI models for your hardware
description: Crewline picks open models for your hardware: Light for any PC, Balanced for 6 GB cards, Best for 10 GB cards.

title: Privacy: customer data never leaves your PC
description: Orders, addresses, voices and photos are processed on your machine. After the models download, it answers offline.

title: Setup: from install to first solved ticket
description: Nine steps from installing Crewline to running your day from one board. Plan on an afternoon.

title: Compare: Crewline vs chatbots, helpdesks, agencies
description: How Crewline compares with chatbot widgets, helpdesks with canned replies and outsourced agents.

title: One day at Fernway: the film and the record
description: An 86-second film about a shop, a torn box and a $1,444 refund, and the record of the day behind it.

title: FAQ: hardware, offline use, setup and limits
description: Common questions about Crewline, including what it doesn't do yet.
